scientific_diagnosis.full_mask_observation_model: A full object mask approximately supplies complete pixel membership, so ordinary pixel-frequency proper BCE is an appropriate posterior calibration objective.
scientific_diagnosis.scribble_observation_model: Positive and negative scribbles are case-control/censored observations. Their sampled pixel frequency is an annotation-design quantity rather than the natural deployment foreground prior, so ordinary pixel-micro BCE incorrectly calibrates it as a posterior and systematically under-selects foreground.
scientific_diagnosis.registered_fix: Fit scribble calibration with equal positive and negative logistic risk inside each train prompt, then average the 17 prompt risks equally. The resulting scalar is a class-symmetric foreground likelihood unary whose fixed 0.5 decision is not set by observed scribble class frequency.

method.name: ObservationConditionedPromptCalibratorV4
method.architecture: one positive temperature and one bias for each source-known mode [full_mask, scribble]

fit.instances: the same 17 frozen V1 train instance IDs only
fit.full_mask_loss: ordinary unweighted pixel-micro BCEWithLogits over all full-mask train prompts and held-out target views
fit.scribble_loss: mean over 17 train prompts of [0.5*mean_positive softplus(-logit) + 0.5*mean_negative softplus(logit)]
fit.scribble_prompt_weighting: each train prompt has weight 1/17 independent of pixels, foreground area, or target-view count
fit.optimizer_per_mode: deterministic full-batch LBFGS with strong-Wolfe line search

evaluation.instances: the same four frozen V1 validation instance IDs [1,12,20,21]

promotion_gate.failure_action: stop this calibration branch before every benchmark target metric; do not try a fifth calibration variant

iteration_status.required_next_step_if_passed: cross-scene clean confirmation before any benchmark
